user.title: Add a KVM device
user.description: Select NanoKVM or JetKVM and enter its address. NanoKVM retains staged setup; JetKVM tests connectivity and the optional local password.

data_description.base_url: For example 192.168.1.50 or nanokvm.local. A full HTTP or HTTPS address is also accepted.

auth.title: Authenticate to NanoKVM
auth.description: Step 2 of 3: connection to {base_url} succeeded. Now test the NanoKVM credentials.

confirm.title: Add NanoKVM
confirm.description: Step 3 of 3: authentication succeeded. Add {title} ({device_key}) at {base_url} to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: KVM device configuration
reauth_confirm.description: Change the connection or password. An empty password keeps the previous one. New settings are tested before replacing the existing configuration.

jetkvm.description: Enter an address and a password only when local authentication is enabled. Home Assistant performs a real connection test; defaults are HTTP and port 80.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach a valid NanoKVM API. Check the address, port, VLAN/firewall rules and whether Home Assistant can reach the device.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid IPv4, IPv6 or DNS host and port 1–65535.
error.permission_denied: The device does not permit this operation for the current session.
error.ssl_error: TLS certificate validation failed. Verify the hostname/certificate, or disable TLS certificate verification only if you trust this NanoKVM and its network.
error.forbidden_target: The address is outside allowed LAN networks or points to a protected local service.
error.dns_error: DNS lookup failed. Check the hostname and Home Assistant DNS/mDNS configuration.
error.connection_refused: The device refused the connection. Check its power and configured port.
error.timeout: The device did not respond in time. Check LAN connectivity.
error.tls_error: TLS verification failed. Check the device certificate and protocol.
error.unreachable: The device is unreachable. Check its address, routing and firewall.
error.not_jetkvm: The host responds but does not expose a compatible JetKVM local API.
error.setup_required: Complete first-time JetKVM setup in its local interface.
error.authentication_required: JetKVM requires a local password. Add it to the device configuration.
error.invalid_password: The device rejected the password. Correct the credentials and test again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before retrying.
error.protocol_error: The device returned an invalid KVM protocol response.
error.busy: This device already has an active Manager KVM session. Disconnect it first.
error.unsupported: This feature is not available for this device or transport.
error.session_required: This operation requires an active Live KVM session.
error.secret_storage: Unable to access KVM secret storage. Check the key and file permissions.
error.wrong_device: The new address belongs to a different device. The previous configuration was not changed.
error.not_found: The KVM device was not found.
